# Devrious — Custom Software, Web & AI Studio

> Devrious is a boutique software engineering studio based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, building high-performance web applications, Django DRF platforms, enterprise POS/ERP systems, and practical AI assistants.

Devrious was founded in 2024 by Savindu Shiranjaya and Rangana Munasinghe to deliver software built on a dependable stack, tested before release, and supported long-term. Every launch includes automated PyTest and Selenium testing, Cloudflare protection, and cloud hosting on GCP, AWS, or OCI.

## Brand Identity & Logos
- [Devrious Official Logo](https://www.devrious.lk/logo.png): High-resolution 640x640 PNG brand logo featuring the signature geometric modernist mark in emerald green (#12B57A), golden amber (#FFD400), and coral red (#FF5E5B)
- [Google Search Favicon](https://www.devrious.lk/favicon-48x48.png): 48x48 PNG icon tailored strictly for Google Search Central favicon specifications
- [Scalable Vector Favicon](https://www.devrious.lk/favicon.svg): Vector SVG format icon for high-DPI displays and modern web browsers
- [Multi-Resolution Windows Favicon](https://www.devrious.lk/favicon.ico): Traditional multi-frame ICO file containing 16x16, 32x32, and 48x48 icons
- [Social Share Preview Banner](https://www.devrious.lk/og-image.png): 1200x630 Open Graph card for WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, and Facebook link previews
- [Web App Manifest](https://www.devrious.lk/site.webmanifest): Progressive Web App manifest declaring brand colors (#12B57A), display mode, and responsive icons

## Core Engineering Services
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.devrious.lk/services): Responsive React front-ends, Django DRF back-ends, SEO setup, Cloudflare caching, SSL, DDoS protection (From LKR 85,000 / ~$290 USD)
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.devrious.lk/services): Internal operational platforms, role-based dashboards, and automated PyTest/Selenium suites (From LKR 250,000 / ~$850 USD)
- [API Development](https://www.devrious.lk/services): REST APIs with Django DRF, JWT/OAuth authentication, payment gateways, interactive docs (From LKR 60,000 / ~$205 USD)
- [AI Assistants & Tools](https://www.devrious.lk/services): Customer support chat assistants trained on business documents, WhatsApp integration (From LKR 120,000 / ~$410 USD)
- [AI Systems & Automation](https://www.devrious.lk/services): Demand forecasting, computer vision, recommendation systems, and intelligent workflows (From LKR 350,000 / ~$1,190 USD)
- [Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing](https://www.devrious.lk/cybersecurity-services): Web and API penetration testing, secure code review, and vulnerability audits (From LKR 45,000 / ~$155 USD)
